name: Nakano Haruhiro
source:
Toshiya's childhood friend and classmate. He has a mature personality and is the type who stays cool under pressure.

He's very open about sex, and in a way, he and Miyuki make a well-matched couple. He has extensive experience with women and shares that knowledge with Toshiya.

He knows full well that Toshiya had sex with his girlfriend Miyuki.
